text:
devon: kicking off a warmup rollout to 2% for prod (slice-a). pushed feature flag `warmup_v1` at 11:03 PT. slow-start routing, watch latency and error budget. tagging @ana @sam for observations.

deploy-bot: deploy started — service=inference-gw image=redwood/infer:2.1.4 slice=slice-a target=2%

ana: acked. dashboards up, I'll monitor p95 and error rate.

sam: oncall here — setting a short alert: 5xx > 0.5% over 1m. ping me on any spike.

kevin: FYI model-fallback is on (quantized-v2) if memory pressure appears. should be seamless.

infra-bot: warmup policy applied: min_replicas=3, slow_start_window=5m for slice-a.

ana: seeing a couple transient 429s from the batcher around 11:05. applied a small rate bump to slice-a (+10 qps) to smooth warmup.

sam: can you paste the log lines you saw?

ana: sure, snippet below:
```
[11:05:06] batcher: reject request id=fc1a24 reason=rate_limit queue_len=12
[11:05:07] batcher: accept request id=fc1a25 batch_size=8 latency_ms=98
[11:05:08] inference: model=decoder-v1 p95=118ms 5xx=0
```

devon: thanks — no blockers from infra or product side. plan is to watch for 20m, then ramp to 10% at ~11:30 if stable.

kevin: quick reminder — CR #789 (routing policy checkbox) is still pending review. @sam can you take a quick look? https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/789

sam: will review in ~15m.

ana: latency holding ~120ms p95, errors dropped after rate bump. continuing watch.

devon: if anyone sees error rate > 1% or p95 > 250ms, I'll flip the flag off (rollback). I have the toggle ready.

sam: noted. ping me if we hit any threshold or at +20m for a thumbs-up.

infra-bot: cluster metrics snapshot: cpu=54% gpu_mem=63% qps_per_node=120. no OOMs.

deploy-bot: deployment completed to slice-a at 11:09:12 — all health checks passed.

ana: final ack for now — no persistent 5xx, handing monitoring to SRE for the +30m window.

devon: thanks team :thumbsup:
